However, checkoutservice->productcatalogservice is slow and checkoutservice's own p95 latency is high (242.92ms), indicating checkoutservice is relaying productcatalogservice's delay, not causing it.

CPU usage of productcatalogservice is 0.004 of 0.010 cores (46% of limit), so it is not CPU throttled, but the CPU limit was recently reduced from 200m to 10m, which may cause resource exhaustion under load.
No errors are reported anywhere, so the fault is latency, not crash or errors.
Pod of productcatalogservice was recreated 331s ago, but the latency issue persists, so this is not a pod_kill recovery.
Therefore, productcatalogservice is the root cause of latency, propagating delays to checkoutservice and frontend.
Propagation path includes checkoutservice and frontend, as they show increased latency downstream of productcatalogservice.
